9th annual · September 16, 2026

All Black Attire Fashion Show & Party

An all-black dress code, a 150-foot red carpet and an alley turned runway in Minneapolis's North Loop.

Presented with luxury boutique MartinPatrick3, the All Black Attire Fashion Show & Party turns the string-lit alley between MartinPatrick3 and the Hewing Hotel into a runway. Guests arrive dressed in black from head to toe and become part of the show.

A professional cast of models, stylists, musicians and performers presents the boutique's fall collections. The event has grown to roughly 400 guests.

For 2026 the evening partners with Coated in Love and its 3,000 Acts of Kindness campaign: guests are invited to bring a coat, gloves or other winter essentials for neighbors experiencing homelessness.
